method: On the gateway host, through the installed registered tools as a master_admin stand-in: client_resolve_account for firm 49financial, then the four client tools on one Black Diamond account it returned; per tool the bucket of the first source key is the DATA_CATALOG row the context resolves for it, cross-read against the bucket the typed_scope S3 helpers were handed; the role is the STS caller identity of the client the adapter used.
role_assumed: unread (no S3 client was created: every one of the four calls was refused at the catalog lookup before any read; the instance role was opal-gateway-role)

tools.note: no source key: absent_reason no_catalog_row -- the adapter's _live_prefix asks ctx.prefix for blackdiamond/49f-live/silver/unrealized/ and the DATA_CATALOG carries no such row
no source key: absent_reason no_catalog_row -- the adapter's _live_prefix asks ctx.prefix for blackdiamond/49f-live/silver/transactions/ and the DATA_CATALOG carries no such row
no source key: absent_reason no_catalog_row -- the adapter's _live_prefix asks ctx.prefix for blackdiamond/49f-live/silver/allocations/ and the DATA_CATALOG carries no such row
no source key: absent_reason no_catalog_row -- the adapter's _live_prefix asks ctx.prefix for blackdiamond/49f-live/silver/fees/ and the DATA_CATALOG carries no such row

finding: None of the four read any bucket: each answered absent_reason no_catalog_row because the DATA_CATALOG carries no blackdiamond/49f-live/silver row for unrealized, transactions, allocations or fees (neither opal-data-bd nor opal-data-assets was read); client_resolve_account, which is not one of the four, reads the opal-data-assets copy of dim_account_xref and returned 2 Black Diamond candidates for one last4.
run_note: Run 1 (deployed commit 38fe44d5cb) omitted the from_date/to_date window that transactions and fees require (absent_reason window_required); ONE further run with a 30-day window corrected it (this record, deployed commit d14445961d). The order said run once, so the second run is disclosed here. Both runs answered no_catalog_row for holdings and allocation; the deployed commit moved between the runs, and the S3 git-ref was equal before and after each.
